description: Traditional PKI: a trusted CA issues X.509 client certs to each kithd. identify_caller verifies the cert chain against the CA root and extracts identity from the subject/SAN. Suitable for enterprise/organizational deployments where the org already runs a CA (Active Directory CS, Vault PKI, step-ca, etc.). Higher operational burden than TOFU/ACME but provides centralized revocation and policy control. The CA root is configured at kithd startup.
title: Auth mechanism: CA-issued X.509 (PKIX)
